tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background and form fields.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Lake mist. Footer, inset panels, summary boxes, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on `surface` (17.0:1) and `surface-alt` (15.2:1). Focus bar. Text on `accent` and `warning`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Hint text, captions, metadata on `surface` (7.2:1) and `surface-alt` (6.4:1).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Lake Kerrow blue. Header band, primary buttons, selected radios. Pair with `on-brand` (8.9:1).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of `brand` fills.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand`, `brand-strong` and `banner`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Dry-season sun. One highlight per screen: the header bar, step markers, a key figure. Fill only – never text on white (1.9:1).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on `accent` fills (9.2:1).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links on `surface` (7.5:1) and `surface-alt` (6.7:1). Always underlined.

tokens.name: link-visited
tokens.usage: Visited links on `surface`.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus fill behind the focused element, always with a 3px `ink` bar beneath – the bar carries the 3:1 contrast.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Form control borders on `surface` (4.5:1) and `surface-alt` (4.0:1).

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers and table rules only – never the edge of a control.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and notice border on `surface` (6.7:1). Always with the word 'Success' and a tick icon.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text, field border and notice border on `surface` (6.7:1). Always with 'Error:' and a cross icon. Same lightness as `success`, so never rely on colour alone.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning notice fill with `ink` text (9.2:1). Never as text.

tokens.name: banner
tokens.usage: Fictional-country banner strip above the header, with `on-brand` text (17.0:1).

tokens.name: radius-md
